source: OpenAlex API /works (IDs written from the response by scripts/run_search.py)
query: "infrastructural citizenship" OR "hydraulic citizenship" OR "infrastructural violence" OR "splintering urbanism"
filter: title_and_abstract.search.exact:"infrastructural citizenship" OR "hydraulic citizenship" OR "infrastructural violence" OR "splintering urbanism",is_retracted:false,publication_year:2022-2026
oql:
get works where retracted is (false)
  and year >= (2022)
  and year <= (2026)
  and title-abstract has ("hydraulic citizenship" OR "infrastructural citizenship" OR "infrastructural violence" OR "splintering urbanism")
